CFML Language Reference: Functions

SpanIncluding

Returns characters from the beginning of a string as long as each one is in a given set.

Category

String functions

Syntax

SpanIncluding(string, set)

Parameters

string
The string to examine.
set
A string of allowed characters.

Returns

The leading characters that are in the set; an empty string if the first character is not.

Usage

Useful for pulling a number off the front of a string, or checking that input consists only of allowed characters: if SpanIncluding(s, set) is the same length as s, every character was allowed.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Digits = "0123456789">
<CFSET Inputs = "1999 Party,42nd Street,No numbers here">
<UL>
<CFLOOP LIST="#Inputs#" INDEX="s">
<CFOUTPUT><LI>"#s#" starts with [#SpanIncluding(s, Digits)#]</CFOUTPUT>
</CFLOOP>
</UL>

See also

SpanExcluding, Val, FindOneOf, REFind
